content_zh:
池灿三人一时有些沉默。
到底是个小姑娘，遇到这样的惨事，心心念念不忘的还是赶紧回家去。朱彦想。
杨二则在想：小姑娘胡乱插话，拾曦该更生气了吧？
池灿确实很生气。
这丫头口口声声说崇敬乔先生，面对乔家灭门却无动于衷，只一心想着尽快回家去，可见心性凉薄，说不定她所谓对乔先生的崇敬也是糊弄他的。
乔昭收回了目光。
她的失态算是勉强应付过去了吧？至于旁人的厌恶，她全然没有心情应对了。
“原来几位贵客是从京城来的，失礼了，失礼了。”村长亲自给四人添了茶水，打破了微妙的尴尬气氛。
乔昭沉浸在自己的思绪中。
按时间推算，自己的死讯还未传到这边来，她的婆家在京城，他们外祖一家也在京城。大哥离开这里，最可能去的地方无疑是那里。
可家里糟了这样的横祸，大哥为什么没有留在杏子林守孝，而是急匆匆离开呢？
乔昭隐隐觉得奇怪，可巨大的悲痛压在心头令她难以深思，便只剩下一个念头：回京城去，一定要找到大哥！
旁人又说了些什么，乔昭全然没有听进去，直到池灿站起来淡淡道：“我们还要赶回嘉丰城里去，就不用饭了。”
她浑浑噩噩跟着三人往外走。
池灿牵着马，眼风不悦扫过来：“磨蹭什么，再不快点，你就留在这里好了。”
乔昭睫毛轻轻颤了颤。
若是可以，她比谁都想留下来，这里是她的家啊！
“真的想留下？”池灿扬眉，越发不耐烦。
乔昭摇摇头，上前一步，冲池灿伸出了手。
池灿毫不客气抓住她手腕，直接提上马。

风声烈烈，如刀割在乔昭脸上，同时割在她心里。
春日的风，原来也这么冷。
乔昭这样想着，最后一次回头，深深看了被抛在身后的村庄一眼。
彼时晚霞满天，与那片隔绝了一切丑陋与美好的杏子林连成了一片，只剩下村庄的静谧安宁。
袅袅炊烟升起，一切都仿若往昔，只有那骑马远去的少女才知道，她失去了什么。
当马蹄溅起的烟尘全然消散时，一道人影从杏子林一隅闪过，同样离开了这里。
乔昭一行人赶在城门关闭前进了城，挑了城中上好的一家客栈住下来。
当城门缓缓合拢后，有人匆匆赶来。
“已经关城门了，想进城明日赶早！”守卫不耐烦道。
那人从怀中掏出一面令牌，在守卫面前一晃。
守卫立刻变了色，结巴道：“原来是……是……”
“啰嗦什么，还不快把门“是！”守卫慌忙“头儿，那是什么人啊？”属下凑过来。
守卫左右环顾一眼，才低声吐出三个令人闻风丧胆的字来：“锦鳞卫！”
那眉眼普通的锦鳞卫在城中极为熟悉地走走绕绕，进了一处院子。
院中海棠树下有一黑衣男子，独坐在石桌前，正自饮自酌，不远处数名男子默默站着。
那锦鳞卫一进来，数名男子立刻神情戒备看过去，一见是他，这才松懈下来。
那人很快来到黑衣男子面前，行礼道：“大人。”
黑衣男子把酒杯放下，看他一眼，问道：“杏子林有什么异常？”
“回禀大人，今日有三男一女去了杏子林，女子作男装打扮，然后四人去见了白云村村长。”男子说到这里顿了顿，接着道，“他们是京城来的，现在已经进城了。”
黑衣男子点点头，转头扫众人一眼。

几名男子立刻一脸肃然。
“你们都去查一查，那几人是什么来路。”
“是。”
翌日，天还未大亮，乔昭四人就悄悄出了城，弃马换船，一路往北而去。
他们的情况很快便报到了黑衣男子那里。
“长容长公主之子池灿，泰宁侯世子朱彦，留兴侯世子杨厚承——”黑衣男子念着三人姓名，语气一顿，波澜不惊的面上带了几分困惑，“黎修撰之女黎三？”
他沉思片刻，喃喃道：“一个小姑娘与那三人，是怎么凑在一起的？”
几名手下皆肃手而立，显然是不敢打断上峰思索。
黑衣男子吩咐下去：“从京城到嘉丰定要经过宝陵，联络驻守宝陵城的锦鳞卫，看他们那边有没有什么信息。”
“大人，杏子林那边呢？”一个眉眼普通的属下问。

content_en:
Chi Can and the other three were silent for a while.
After all, she was a little girl, and when she encountered such a tragic incident, she always wanted to go home quickly. Zhu Yan thought.
Yang Er was thinking: The little girl interrupted randomly, should Xi Xi be even more angry?
Chi Chan was indeed angry.
This girl keeps saying that she respects Mr. Qiao, but she is indifferent when the Qiao family is wiped out. She only wants to go home as soon as possible. This shows that she has a cold heart. Maybe her so-called respect for Mr. Qiao is also to fool him.
Qiao Zhao withdrew his gaze.
Was she able to cope with her gaffe? As for the disgust of others, she was completely in no mood to deal with it.
"It turns out that these distinguished guests are from the capital. I'm sorry, I'm sorry." The village chief personally refilled the tea for the four of them, breaking the subtle awkward atmosphere.
Qiao Zhao was immersed in his own thoughts.
Judging from the time, the news of her death has not reached here yet. Her husband's family is in the capital, and their maternal grandfather's family is also in the capital. When eldest brother leaves here, the most likely place to go is undoubtedly there.
But with such a misfortune in the family, why didn't the eldest brother stay in the apricot forest to observe his filial piety, but left in a hurry?
Qiao Zhao felt vaguely strange, but the huge grief in her heart made it difficult for her to think deeply. She only had one thought left: When she returns to the capital, she must find her eldest brother!
Others said something else, but Qiao Zhao didn't listen at all until Chi Can stood up and said calmly: "We have to rush back to Jiafeng City, so we don't need to eat."
She followed the three people out in a daze.
Chi Can held the horse and glanced over with displeasure: "What are you waiting for? If you don't hurry up, you can stay here."
Qiao Zhao's eyelashes trembled slightly.
If possible, she wants to stay more than anyone else. This is her home!
"Really want to stay?" Chi Can raised his eyebrows, becoming more and more impatient.
Qiao Zhao shook his head, took a step forward, and extended his hand to Chi Can.
Chi Can grabbed her wrist without politeness and lifted her directly onto the horse.
The sound of the wind was fierce, like a knife cutting into Qiao Zhao's face and her heart at the same time.
The spring wind turns out to be so cold.
Qiao Zhao thought like this, looking back for the last time and taking a deep look at the village left behind.
At that time, the sky was full of sunset, and it was connected with the apricot forest that had cut off all the ugliness and beauty, leaving only the tranquility of the village.
The smoke rose from the kitchen, and everything seemed like the past. Only the girl who was riding away knew what she had lost.
When the smoke and dust splashed by the horse's hooves completely dissipated, a figure flashed from a corner of the apricot forest and also left here.
Qiao Zhao and his party rushed into the city before the city gate closed and chose a good inn in the city to stay.
When the city gate slowly closed, someone hurried over.
"The city gate has been closed. I want to enter the city early tomorrow!" the guard said impatiently.
The man took out a token from his arms and waved it in front of the guard.
The guard immediately changed his expression and stammered: "It turns out... it's..."
"What are you talking about? Why don't you open the door quickly?" "Yes!" The guard hurriedly asked, "Boss, who is that?" "The subordinates came over.
The guard looked around and then uttered three frightening words in a low voice: "Jinlin Guard! "
The Jinlin Guard with ordinary eyebrows walked around the city very familiarly and entered a courtyard.
There was a man in black under the crabapple tree in the courtyard, sitting alone in front of a stone table, drinking by himself. Not far away were several men standing silently.
As soon as the Jinlin Guard came in, several men immediately looked over with wary expressions. When they saw it was him, they relaxed.
The man quickly came to the man in black and saluted: "Sir. "
The man in black put down his wine glass, glanced at him, and asked, "What's wrong with the apricot forest? "
"Reporting to your lord, today three men and one woman went to Apricot Grove. The woman dressed up in men's clothes, and then the four of them went to see the head of Baiyun Village. The man paused for a moment before saying, "They are from the capital and have entered the city now." "
The man in black nodded and turned to scanEveryone glanced.
Several men immediately looked solemn.
"You all go and find out where those people are from."
"Yes."
The next day, before dawn, Qiao Zhao and the others quietly left the city, abandoned their horses for boats, and headed north.
Their situation was quickly reported to the man in black.
"Chi Can, the son of Princess Changrong, Zhu Yan, the Crown Prince of Taining, and Yang Houcheng, the Crown Prince of Liuxing—" the man in black read out the names of the three people, then paused, with a bit of confusion on his calm face, "Li San, the daughter of Li Xiuzhuan?"
He pondered for a moment and murmured: "How did a little girl and those three people get together?"
Several of his subordinates stood with their hands solemnly, obviously not daring to interrupt Shangfeng's thinking.
The man in black ordered: "From the capital to Jiafeng, we must pass through Baoling. Contact the Jinlin Guards stationed in Baoling City to see if they have any information."
"Sir, where is the apricot forest?" asked a subordinate with ordinary eyebrows.
